english: This has not been confirmed yet.
answers: Abhi iski tasdeeq nahin hui.
explanation: Feminine tasdeeq takes hui.

prompt: Translate into Roman Urdu: In my experience, this method works.
roman: Mere tajurbe mein yeh tareeqa kaam karta hai.
english: In my experience, this method works.
answers: Mere tajurbe mein yeh tareeqa kaam karta hai.
explanation: The opening makes the evidence personal rather than universal.

prompt: Translate into Roman Urdu: Let me put it another way. (Female speaker.)
roman: Main doosre tareeqe se kehti hoon.
english: Let me put it another way. (Female speaker.)
answers: Main doosre tareeqe se kehti hoon.
explanation: Kehti identifies the speaker; doosre tareeqe se means in another way.

prompt: Choose the inference form: Ab tak woh pahunch gaye ___.
roman: honge
english: By now they have probably arrived.
answers: honge
explanation: Honge provides the probable-completion reading in this context.

prompt: Complete the relative link: Jo log aa rahe hain, ___ bata dijiye.
roman: unko
english: Please tell the people who are coming.
answers: unko
explanation: Unko refers back to plural jo log.

prompt: Choose instead of: chaar ke ___ paanch baje.
roman: bajaaye
english: At five instead of four.
answers: bajaaye
explanation: Ke bajaaye replaces one option with another.

prompt: Choose a limited claim: Mere ___ mein yeh kaam karta hai. Meaning: In my experience.
roman: tajurbe
english: In my experience, this works.
answers: tajurbe
explanation: Mere tajurbe mein attributes the judgement to personal experience.

prompt: Choose the causative: Maine kapre ___. Meaning: I had the clothes washed.
roman: dhulwaaye
english: I had the clothes washed.
answers: dhulwaaye
explanation: Dhulwaaye says the speaker arranged washing by someone else.

prompt: Complete: Kaam baant ___ hain. Meaning: Let us divide the work.
roman: dete
english: Let us divide the work.
answers: dete
explanation: Baant dete hain is a collaborative immediate proposal in context.

prompt: Listen, then type the Roman Urdu sentence and its English meaning.
roman: Programme itwaar ko hai, lekin waqt badal gaya hai.
english: The event is on Sunday, but the time has changed.
answers: Programme itwaar ko hai, lekin waqt badal gaya hai.
explanation: Separate the unchanged day from the changed time.

prompt: Listen, then type the Roman Urdu sentence and its English meaning.
roman: Pehle logon ki tadaad tasdeeq kar lete hain.
english: Let us first confirm the number of people.
answers: Pehle logon ki tadaad tasdeeq kar lete hain.
explanation: Pehle marks the first task; tadaad is number/count.

prompt: Listen, then type the Roman Urdu sentence and its English meaning.
roman: Hamaare ghar mein aksar aisa hota hai.
english: This often happens in our home.
answers: Hamaare ghar mein aksar aisa hota hai.
explanation: Aksar means often, not always.

prompt: Listen, then type the Roman Urdu sentence and its English meaning.
roman: Unhone kaha hai ki shaayad der hogi.
english: They have said there may be a delay.
answers: Unhone kaha hai ki shaayad der hogi.
explanation: The report preserves shaayad rather than making the delay certain.

prompt: Listen, then type the Roman Urdu sentence and its English meaning.
roman: Har cheez pehle behtar nahin thi.
english: Not everything was better before.
answers: Har cheez pehle behtar nahin thi.
explanation: Har cheez with nahin limits the claim about the past.

prompt: Listen, then type the Roman Urdu sentence and its English meaning.
roman: Hau, kaam baant lete hain.
english: Yes, let us divide the work.
answers: Hau, kaam baant lete hain.
explanation: Local hau responds affirmatively before the shared proposal.

prompt: Say the target aloud, then extend the idea in your own words.

answers: Jab aap chhoti thin to aapka mohalla kaisa tha?
explanation: Address an older woman respectfully and invite an extended answer.

prompt: Say the target aloud, then extend the idea in your own words.

prompt: Say the target aloud, then extend the idea in your own words.

prompt: Say the target aloud, then extend the idea in your own words.

prompt: Say the target aloud, then extend the idea in your own words.
